en.dr-ali-peiravi: 5-100 Muhammad ibn al-Hassan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Muhammad ibn al-Hassan al-Saffar quoted Ahmad ibn Aba Abdullah al-Barqy, on the authority of Isma’il ibn Mihran, on the authority of Sayf ibn Umayrih, on the authority of Suleimanibn Ja’far an’Nakha’ee, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Muslim and others, on the authority of Abi Ja’far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir (MGB), “The Prophet of God (MGB) was asked about the best of the people. He (MGB) replied, ‘They are the ones who rejoice when they do good, and repent when they do evil. They thank you when you do something good for them, and persevere in the face of calamities. They forgive (others) when they get angry.’”
